_note: Lane D (#23) test-local fixture. Captured from a real backend: seeded STUDY-HLX-028 frozen against a temporary qualified copy of the governed tree (flag off), fixture validation, synthetic dispositions, then per-role approvals (QAU, pathologist, peer, study director), Final Study Approval, and one explicit export plus its idempotent replay. `review` is a full workspace minus data_validation_executions (tests keep the live value); later states are field deltas over `review`. `demo_review` is the same flow with HELIX_DEMO_UNQUALIFIED_PACKAGES=1 on the shipped (pending) tree, as a delta over `review`. Artifact bytes are the real downloaded bytes (base64).

blocks.text: STUDY-HLX-028 is a synthetic 28-day study in Sprague-Dawley rat. Quality assurance and study director signatures remain controlled human records.
The study evaluated repeat-dose oral toxicity under protocol version 3.0. Protocol changes and deviations remain linked records.

fields.label: Test and control article identity and characteristics
Circumstances affecting data quality or integrity
fields.source_expectation: Deviation log and study director assessment

fields.label: Transformations, calculations, and operations
fields.source_expectation: Versioned transform registry and statistical programs

blocks.text: Forty animals received oral gavage dosing for 28 days. The planned groups were Control 0 mg/kg/day, Low 10 mg/kg/day, Mid 30 mg/kg/day, High 100 mg/kg/day.
Formulation concentrations were taken from signed synthetic analytical records. Each result retains its concentration and timepoint grain.

blocks.text: Body weight records were summarized by sex with the mean-by-sex-v1 transform.
Terminal mean body weight in high-dose males was 310.7 g (n=5).
Terminal mean body weight in high-dose females was 261.8 g (n=5).

output.title: Typed source records

stages.name: Deterministic extraction
stages.summary: Code reads the selected source rows and computes report-ready values at the required grain.
stages.control_boundary: The model selects tools and evidence. Deterministic code reads values and performs math.

stages.summary: Rules check keys, terminology, units, grain, authority, aggregation and source-to-report reconciliation.
stages.control_boundary: A failed rule creates a blocker. The agent cannot downgrade it to green.

stages.name: Structured section drafting
stages.summary: Report sections are assembled around validated claims with explicit review markers for unresolved fields.
stages.control_boundary: The model may write prose. It may not invent a value or make the final scientific judgment.

stages.name: Compile provenance
stages.summary: Every report claim is linked to exact source records, the deterministic transform, validation results and manifest version.
stages.control_boundary: A numeric claim without a provenance edge cannot pass its section gate.

stages.name: Traceability review
stages.summary: A reviewer records a disposition for every blocking result before review and export opens.

output.title: Recorded dispositions
output.detail: each blocker resolved by a named reviewer

stages.control_boundary: Agent execution stops here. A disposition is recorded as a disposition, never as a pass.

stages.name: Review, sign and export
stages.summary: Reviewers sign, the Study Director records Final Study Approval, and an explicit export command releases artifacts.
stages.control_boundary: Approvals can make export ready. Only the explicit export command completes this stage.

stages.name: Authorized upload and frozen manifest
stages.summary: The study owner authorizes each source. HELIX freezes checksums, authority, and lock state.
stages.input_detail: 10 protocol, template, data, statistics, and pattern inputs
stages.output_detail: Checksums, authority tiers, and owner authorization
stages.boundary: The agent cannot add an unapproved source.

stages.name: Parse protocol, template, and source data
stages.summary: The supplied bundle represents frozen artifacts as typed facts without changing source records.
stages.input_detail: Authorized synthetic protocol, template, and source representations
stages.boundary: Parsing may flag ambiguity. It may not repair raw study data.

stages.name: Resolve study type and pattern
stages.summary: HELIX matches the protocol to the 28-day repeat-dose profile and its sponsor template.
stages.input_detail: Species, route, duration, endpoints, and study start date
stages.boundary: Approved reports guide structure and phrasing. Their values never enter this study.

stages.name: Deterministic extraction
stages.summary: Code selects source rows and computes report-ready values at the field's required grain.
stages.input_detail: BW, CL, FW, OM, MI, and PC domains
stages.output_detail: Values, units, grain, and versioned transform IDs
stages.boundary: The planner selects tools. Deterministic code reads values and performs math.

stages.name: Hybrid validation
stages.summary: Rules check keys, grain, provenance, report coverage, and source reconciliation.
stages.input_detail: Typed claims plus report rules
stages.output_detail: Deterministic results and constrained agent-proposed tool checks
stages.boundary: An LLM can propose an allowlisted check. It cannot set the result.

stages.name: Structured section drafting
stages.summary: The structured assembler writes around validated claims and preserves explicit review markers.
stages.input_detail: Current facts kept separate from prior-report style
stages.output_detail: Typed blocks, claims, and review markers
stages.boundary: Automation cannot invent values or own final scientific judgment.

stages.name: Compile provenance
stages.summary: Each quantitative claim links to source records, a transform, validation, and manifest state.
stages.input_detail: Current report fields
stages.boundary: A numeric claim without provenance cannot pass its section gate.

stages.name: Section and release gates
stages.summary: The service combines validation, dispositions, approvals, and package preflight.
stages.input_detail: 8 sections and 13 results
stages.boundary: Only recorded dispositions and approvals can change release state.

stages.name: Review and approval
stages.summary: Qualified people resolve findings, perform peer review, provide the QAU statement, and approve.
stages.input_detail: Review markers, lineage, and audit events
stages.boundary: People own scientific interpretation, Quality Assurance Unit work, and final approval.

stages.name: Explicit final export
stages.summary: After release approval, a user separately exports the locked synthetic package.
stages.input_detail: Report and illustrative data support files
stages.boundary: Preparation never triggers export. Export packages approved hashes only; never FDA acceptance.
